def Research.DerivativeSwitch.ConjugateLocalTransport.conjugation.{u_2} : {G : Type u_2} →
  [inst : Group.{u_2} G] →
    (H : @Subgroup.{u_2} G inst) →
      [@Subgroup.Normal.{u_2} G inst H] →
        G →
          @MonoidHom.{u_2, u_2} (↥H) (↥H)
            (@MulOneClass.toMulOne.{u_2} (↥H)
              (@SubmonoidClass.toMulOneClass.{u_2, u_2} G
                (@Monoid.toMulOneClass.{u_2} G (@DivInvMonoid.toMonoid.{u_2} G (@Group.toDivInvMonoid.{u_2} G inst)))
                (@Subgroup.{u_2} G inst) (@Subgroup.instSetLike.{u_2} G inst) ⋯ H))
            (@MulOneClass.toMulOne.{u_2} (↥H)
              (@SubmonoidClass.toMulOneClass.{u_2, u_2} G
                (@Monoid.toMulOneClass.{u_2} G (@DivInvMonoid.toMonoid.{u_2} G (@Group.toDivInvMonoid.{u_2} G inst)))
                (@Subgroup.{u_2} G inst) (@Subgroup.instSetLike.{u_2} G inst) ⋯ H)) :=
fun {G} [inst : Group.{u_2} G] H [@Subgroup.Normal.{u_2} G inst H] a =>
  @MonoidHom.mk.{u_2, u_2} (↥H) (↥H)
    (@MulOneClass.toMulOne.{u_2} (↥H)
      (@SubmonoidClass.toMulOneClass.{u_2, u_2} G
        (@Monoid.toMulOneClass.{u_2} G (@DivInvMonoid.toMonoid.{u_2} G (@Group.toDivInvMonoid.{u_2} G inst)))
        (@Subgroup.{u_2} G inst) (@Subgroup.instSetLike.{u_2} G inst) ⋯ H))
    (@MulOneClass.toMulOne.{u_2} (↥H)
      (@SubmonoidClass.toMulOneClass.{u_2, u_2} G
        (@Monoid.toMulOneClass.{u_2} G (@DivInvMonoid.toMonoid.{u_2} G (@Group.toDivInvMonoid.{u_2} G inst)))
        (@Subgroup.{u_2} G inst) (@Subgroup.instSetLike.{u_2} G inst) ⋯ H))
    (@OneHom.mk.{u_2, u_2} (↥H) (↥H)
      (@MulOne.toOne.{u_2} (↥H)
        (@MulOneClass.toMulOne.{u_2} (↥H)
          (@SubmonoidClass.toMulOneClass.{u_2, u_2} G
            (@Monoid.toMulOneClass.{u_2} G (@DivInvMonoid.toMonoid.{u_2} G (@Group.toDivInvMonoid.{u_2} G inst)))
            (@Subgroup.{u_2} G inst) (@Subgroup.instSetLike.{u_2} G inst) ⋯ H)))
      (@MulOne.toOne.{u_2} (↥H)
        (@MulOneClass.toMulOne.{u_2} (↥H)
          (@SubmonoidClass.toMulOneClass.{u_2, u_2} G
            (@Monoid.toMulOneClass.{u_2} G (@DivInvMonoid.toMonoid.{u_2} G (@Group.toDivInvMonoid.{u_2} G inst)))
            (@Subgroup.{u_2} G inst) (@Subgroup.instSetLike.{u_2} G inst) ⋯ H)))
      (fun h =>
        @Subtype.mk.{u_2 + 1} G
          (fun x =>
            @Membership.mem.{u_2, u_2} G (@Subgroup.{u_2} G inst)
              (@SetLike.instMembership.{u_2, u_2} (@Subgroup.{u_2} G inst) G (@Subgroup.instSetLike.{u_2} G inst)) H x)
          (@HMul.hMul.{u_2, u_2, u_2} G G G
            (@instHMul.{u_2} G
              (@MulOne.toMul.{u_2} G
                (@MulOneClass.toMulOne.{u_2} G
                  (@Monoid.toMulOneClass.{u_2} G
                    (@DivInvMonoid.toMonoid.{u_2} G (@Group.toDivInvMonoid.{u_2} G inst))))))
            (@HMul.hMul.{u_2, u_2, u_2} G G G
              (@instHMul.{u_2} G
                (@MulOne.toMul.{u_2} G
                  (@MulOneClass.toMulOne.{u_2} G
                    (@Monoid.toMulOneClass.{u_2} G
                      (@DivInvMonoid.toMonoid.{u_2} G (@Group.toDivInvMonoid.{u_2} G inst))))))
              a
              (@Subtype.val.{u_2 + 1} G
                (fun x =>
                  @Membership.mem.{u_2, u_2} G (@Subgroup.{u_2} G inst)
                    (@SetLike.instMembership.{u_2, u_2} (@Subgroup.{u_2} G inst) G (@Subgroup.instSetLike.{u_2} G inst))
                    H x)
                h))
            (@Inv.inv.{u_2} G
              (@InvOneClass.toInv.{u_2} G
                (@DivInvOneMonoid.toInvOneClass.{u_2} G
                  (@DivisionMonoid.toDivInvOneMonoid.{u_2} G (@Group.toDivisionMonoid.{u_2} G inst))))
              a))
          ⋯)

                      (@Module.End.{u, u} R V (@CommSemiring.toSemiring.{u} R (@CommRing.toCommSemiring.{u} R inst))

            G →
              @LinearMap.{u, u, u, u} R R (@CommSemiring.toSemiring.{u} R (@CommRing.toCommSemiring.{u} R inst))

                  (@Semiring.toNonAssocSemiring.{u} R
                    (@CommSemiring.toSemiring.{u} R (@CommRing.toCommSemiring.{u} R inst))))

                    fun i =>
                    @AddCommGroup.toAddCommMonoid.{u}
                      (@Rep.V.{u, u, u} R G (@CommSemiring.toSemiring.{u} R (@CommRing.toCommSemiring.{u} R inst))

                      (@Rep.hV1.{u, u, u} R G (@CommSemiring.toSemiring.{u} R (@CommRing.toCommSemiring.{u} R inst))
